license_note: Literary excerpts are public domain; other examples were constructed for this investigation.

contract.coverage: Every lexical source span maps to spoken text/phonemes, or an explicit frozen dictionary suppression. Unresolved spans abort the job visibly.
contract.normalization: Persist original UTF-16 -> normalized spoken -> phoneme span mappings, including number expansions and punctuation transformations.
contract.phoneme_inventory: All output phonemes must map to the existing Kokoro token inventory; do not silently filter unknown symbols.
contract.success: Nonempty finite 24 kHz audio plus coverage checks. Generation success alone is not pronunciation correctness.
contract.manual_review: Listen for names, homographs, dates, abbreviations, dialogue phrasing, quality and chunk joins.
contract.failure: Do not promote partial/empty audio to a successful recording or overwrite an existing successful WAV.

cases.source: Jane Austen, Pride and Prejudice (1813), chapter 1
cases.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
cases.check: Every lexical source span must have a spoken mapping; preserve the sentence boundary.

cases.source: Lewis Carroll, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865), chapter 1; quotation typography adapted
cases.text: Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice “without pictures or conversations?”
cases.check: All narration and dialogue must be represented. Curly quote characters need not be spoken.

cases.text: “I can’t believe it’s John’s,” she said. ‘Don’t leave—wait…’
cases.check: Retain the meanings of can't, it's, John's and don't; preserve dialogue and pause boundaries.

cases.text: She arrived, opened the boxes, and carried the books. The children’s toys were scattered.
cases.check: Inflected and possessive words must all yield nonempty phoneme coverage.

cases.text: Dr. Siobhán O’Connor met Quvenzhané near Worcestershire; Xylophonia was their destination.
cases.check: No name may be omitted. Approximate name pronunciations require listening review; expose neural/fallback use.

cases.text: She bought 3 books for $1,234.50, saved 12.5%, and walked 2.5 km.
cases.check: Each numeric expression must have a normalized spoken expansion with original-span mapping; never discard its digits.

cases.text: On November 13, 2026, at 9:05 a.m., Mr. Jones returned.
cases.check: Document date/year/time expansion; retain month, day, year, hour and minute. Do not mistake abbreviation periods for sentence endings.
Require a declared locale policy or explicit ambiguity handling. US and UK expectations differ; no universal pronunciation is asserted.

cases.text: Mrs. Brown visited Dr. Smith at St. James’s; the U.S. team arrived at 5 p.m.
cases.check: Recognize titles and initialisms; manually review Saint/Street and time interpretation.

cases.text:
“Will you return?” Anna asked.

“Yes,” he replied. “Tomorrow.”
cases.check: Retain all spoken words and paragraph/dialogue boundaries. No model chunk may exceed 510 content tokens.

cases.text:
The café was quiet—almost too quiet… A ﬁne façade glowed in the sun. They chose to co­operate.

Café windows shone.
cases.check: Handle NBSP, em dash, ellipsis, fi ligature, accents, combining accent and soft hyphen with explicit normalization mappings. Preserve fine and cooperate.

cases.text: Worcestershire was written on the sign.
cases.expected_transformed_text: Wooster was written on the sign.
cases.check: Apply frozen text substitutions before G2P. Retain original-to-spoken UTF-16 mapping; do not treat the replacement as an IPA lexicon entry.
Only the explicitly silenced ornament span may lose spoken coverage. All prose must remain represented.

cases.text: The signal was *bright*, and the answer was 3 × 4.
cases.check: Do not use blanket symbol stripping: retain bright and the multiplication meaning. Unsupported expressions must produce a visible failure, never disappear.
Do not create a successful empty WAV.

cases.text: Anna read the sign: 你好.
cases.check: Unsupported non-English content must not be silently removed from an otherwise successful recording.
